rationale: Consumer 'personal AI' chat surface at pi.ai, originally built by Inflection AI on the Inflection-2.5 model. Most of Inflection's frontier-model team and IP licensed to Microsoft in March 2024 under a $650M acquihire deal; the Pi consumer product remained with the residual Inflection entity, which has since pivoted toward enterprise. Governance posture is consumer-grade: no public SOC2/ISO trust portal for the Pi product, no published model card for Inflection-2.5 or its successor, no published red-teaming reports, no public uptime SLA, no published bias/safety scorecard. Eval coverage is opaque (no model card). The product itself is well-known and recognizable; the governance scaffolding around it is thin compared to OpenAI/Anthropic/Google. Bias and adversarial robustness are difficult to assess externally because the model is closed-weights and the surface blocks scraping (403 on direct curl). Treat as a 'consumer chat' archetype prior, not a measurement.
